description: Turns any web address into a one.design link that asks for a password before opening it. The address is encrypted here (AES-256-GCM); the result carries it in the link itself, so no server stores it. Anyone with the link and the password can open it.

hint.description: Optional hint shown before the password. Anyone with the link can read it.

password.description: The password people will need. It is not stored anywhere.

url.description: The address to protect, e.g. drive.google.com/… (https:// is added if missing).

name: lock_link
title: Lock a link behind a password
